source.datasheet_title: i.MX RT1060 Crossover Processors for Consumer Products

notes: total_flash_bytes is deliberately null: the bare die has no embedded flash at all -- flash is external SPI/QSPI chosen per board, not a chip-level constant like SRAM. Confirmed directly from the datasheet's own memory-interfaces list, which enumerates only external options (SDRAM, SLC NAND flash, SD/eMMC, SPI NOR/NAND flash, parallel NOR flash with XIP) -- no on-die flash exists anywhere in the sections read. Teensy 4.0 pairs it with a 2 MB external QSPI flash chip, Teensy 4.1 with 8 MB; both are board-level choices, not RT1062 spec, which is why both boards are listed as aliases here despite differing board flash. total_sram_bytes (1 MB) is confirmed directly: 'The i.MX RT1060 processor has 1 MB on-chip RAM. 512 KB can be flexibly configured as TCM or general purpose on-chip RAM, while the other 512 KB is general-purpose on-chip RAM.' This datasheet covers the RT1060 family and explicitly lists the MIMXRT1062DVJ6A/DVL6A part numbers used on Teensy 4.x in its ordering table. Read via a PJRC (Teensy maker)-hosted mirror of NXP's own PDF, 119 pp., verified directly.
